name: ts-jvm
description: A tiny JVM written in TypeScript - parses real .class files and interprets bytecode

scripts.run: npm run compile && npm run build && node dist/jvm.js
scripts.hello: npm run compile && npm run build && node dist/jvm.js HelloWorld
scripts.calc: npm run compile && npm run build && node dist/jvm.js Calc
scripts.fact: npm run compile && npm run build && node dist/jvm.js Factorial
scripts.dog: npm run compile && npm run build && node dist/jvm.js Dog
scripts.add: npm run compile && npm run build && node dist/jvm.js Add
scripts.puppy: npm run compile && npm run build && node dist/jvm.js Puppy
scripts.arr: npm run compile && npm run build && node dist/jvm.js ArrayTest
